title: Mackenyu Will Appear at London MCM Comic Con in October
content: The MCM London Comic Con has announced on its X/Twitter feed that the actor Mackenyu , who plays Roronoa Zoro in the live-action One Piece webseries, will appear at the event which runs from Friday October 23 to Sunday October 25. The venue is London's ExCel Centre. Mackenyu will appear on the Saturday and Sunday.
author: ANN

title: Pokémon Permanently Banned An Episode That Was Deemed Too Dangerous to Air, & It Was Pikachu’s Fault
content: There are plenty of ways an episode of Pokémon can become memorable. Maybe Ash catches a new Pokémon, Team Rocket gets blasted off again, or Pikachu finds himself in the middle of another adventure that somehow goes completely off the rails.

title: Crunchyroll Manga App Expands to U.K., Ireland, South Asia, ANZ
content: Crunchyroll also announced that it will be "easily accessible" in a new dedicated anime hub for the PlayStation 5 console that will launch next spring. The anime space on the console will also include anime games and anime-inspired games.

title: 20 Years Later, There’s Still No Shonen Jump Anime That Deserves a Reboot More
content: When it comes to Shonen action and drama, Weekly Shonen Jump always grabs the spotlight, and this has been the case for many decades now. Established in 1968, it eventually became the best-selling manga magazine of all time.

title: Walking Home with You Anime Reveals Visual, April 2027 Premiere
content: Walking Home with You anime revealed a new visual along with an April 2027 premiere date on Wednesday. No further details on the studio, staff, or cast were announced as of this writing. Mai Matsuda writes and illustrates the manga which the anime is based on.
